name: NES Emulator
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Play NES game ROMs in the player
description:
Runs iNES ROMs with JSNES; picture and sound play in the player like any other media.
.nes files open like media: Open File, a drop on the video, the playlist; the Emulator context menu opens and stops them too. No keyboard controls or save states yet; no games included.
